name: skyrim-vr-automation
description: Codex skills for transactional Skyrim VR automation, local feedback, correlated capture and interaction, DevBench profiling, and reusable shader-cache management.

interface.shortDescription: Safe Skyrim VR test and profiling controls.
interface.longDescription: Adds safety-bounded workflows for exact-profile Mod Organizer 2 sessions, correlated state/stereo capture and in-game actions, transactional profile edits, compatibility-ranked compiled shader-cache reuse, backed-up SteamVR null-HMD switching, identity-bound DevBench calls, profiler captures, bounded process retries, and a durable local automation-feedback mailbox.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my configured MO2 environment safely.
Switch SteamVR to null HMD with a recoverable backup.
Run a bounded Skyrim VR test session through MO2.
Record and triage local feedback about the automation toolkit.
Capture and compare CSX profiler evidence.
Prepare this task with the best compatible known-working compiled shader cache.
Observe and interact with Skyrim VR through one correlated state and stereo capture session.
